name: University of Auckland
description: The University of Auckland is a public research university in Auckland, founded in 1883. With over 40,000 students it is New Zealand's largest university.
whyIncluded: Its MB ChB is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications and its LL.B is on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's list of approved overseas universities (graduates in the top 70% of their cohort).

livingCosts.notes: University of Auckland Business School 'Living costs' list (the main auckland.ac.nz cost-of-living page gives no full estimate; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints. Housing: rent $200-$300/wk x 52/12. Food: groceries $100-$150/wk x 52/12. Transport: monthly bus pass $200-$250. Personal: phone plan $30-$40/month + gym membership $319/yr / 12; excludes entertainment (the university's accommodation page suggests ~$70/wk for entertainment and gym). The page's headline is NZ$20,000-$25,000 a year (NZ$400-$450/wk) for accommodation, food and transport.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts
programmes.notes: 2026 estimated international fee for 120 points, excluding performance and science-based courses (those NZ$48,133). Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point Arts course fee from that year's international Arts fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws
programmes.notes: 2026 estimated international fee for 120 points (8 x 15-point LAW course at NZ$5,902.20; 480 points over 4 years). LLB Part I is 45 points of law plus 75 points from another degree, so the first year is a little lower. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point LAW course fee from that year's international Law fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Master of Laws
programmes.notes: 2026 international fee for 120 points of 700-level LAW courses (8 x 15-point LAW 760 at NZ$6,074.40, or 4 x 30-point LAW 701 at NZ$12,148.80); taught or research LLM, 1 year. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120. 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point 700-level LAW course fee from that year's schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MB ChB)
programmes.notes: First-year rate: the 2026 estimated international fee for the Year 1 (overlapping BHSc / Biomedical Science year, 120 points at NZ$5,352.30 per 15-point course), which the programme list quotes for MB ChB Year 1. Years 2 to 6 are NZ$86,561 a year (MBChB Part II-VI, 2 x 60-point halves at NZ$43,280.40 each; Part III is 105 points, NZ$75,740.70), so the six-year total is about NZ$475,600. 720 points over 6 years. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120. 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point Year 1 course fee (MEDSCI 142 / POPLHLTH) from that year's international Medical and Health Sciences schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point; MBChB Part II was NZ$83,232 in 2024 and NZ$86,560.80 in 2025.
